subject: Decreased number of sites on reading bismark cytosine report

messages.author: 4dfa7d97e5f38a05
messages.subject: Decreased number of sites on reading bismark cytosine report
parts:
Hi,

I have aligned my RRBS data using BisMark followed by methylation extraction by the same tool. In the CytosineReport file, I see that there are 58974122 lines or sites. However, on reading using methylRead(), the number of sites decreases a bit but after unite(), it reduces just to a few hundreds. Why might that be?

Thank you,
Arindam
